layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room grid. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). High density. Strict column alignment for widgets.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Containers with border-collapse style layout, border-r and border-b. No heavy drop shadows. Crisp edges.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-stone-200), no shadow. On hover, border color darkens slightly, no lift to maintain Swiss grid rigidity.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none), high contrast. Primary: bg-stone-900 text-white hover:bg-stone-800. Accent: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600. ALWAYS set hover text color explicitly.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI base. Square corners (rounded-none), 1px solid border. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-stone-900 focus:ring-offset-1.
components.tables: Strict cell borders (border-stone-200). Sticky headers with uppercase labels. Right-aligned numerical data.
components.kanban: Strict columns with light stone background (bg-stone-50). Cards have a solid 1px border. Use left-border color accents to denote status (e.g., orange for negotiation, green for converted).
components.receipt: High-contrast, printable layout. Focus on monochrome clarity, utilizing grid borders heavily.

motion.strategy: Minimalist. Snappy transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out). Micro-interactions for button presses and row hovers. No bouncy animations.

logo.description: Sankalp Group Logo - Minimalist architectural vector

login_background.description: Minimalist architectural concrete texture for login page background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Light Theme and Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Remove generic rounding (like rounded-lg, rounded-md) from Shadcn UI primitives, setting them to rounded-none to reflect an architectural aesthetic.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements MUST include a role-based data-testid attribute.
Import Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local assets) and IBM Plex Sans (from Google Fonts) in the main HTML/CSS layer.
For the dashboard layout, use the 'Control Room' grid layout: tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6), rigid alignment, utilizing 100% of available space. Grid items must align exactly to edges.

The login page must use the provided login_background image covering the full screen. Place the login form within a stark white solid panel (bg-white p-12) to create maximal contrast with the background texture.
Kanban board columns should feel structural and organized, utilizing rigid grid borders rather than floating stylized cards.
Maintain color contrast standards. The accent color (orange) is specifically for critical infrastructure-like alerts or key actions, not for general decoration.
